supporting_observations.claim: Seven logged connections from WS-LMARTINS-01 to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 occurred from 13:35:56 to 14:05:48 UTC, at roughly five-minute intervals.

The observed timing is broadly consistent with the inventory-listed PixelForge updater's approximately five-minute update checks, but the records do not identify the process or destination service, so this match is suggestive rather than conclusive.
The supplied network records show connections to the internal proxy on port 8080; they do not themselves show a direct outbound HTTPS connection or identify the external destination.

Internal SMB connections to DC-NWD-01 are also recorded, with successful network logons for the workstation machine account; these records do not establish that the activity was malicious or tied to the proxy connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy connection records identify the workstation, proxy, port, timing, and byte counts, but provide no URL, external host, TLS details, or originating process attribution (T036-00101, T036-00144, T036-00178, T036-00208, T036-00235, T036-00242, T036-00256).

The supplied records contain no process-to-network event linking the periodic proxy connections to PixelForge's updater or to another executable (T036-00101, T036-00144, T036-00178, T036-00208, T036-00235, T036-00242, T036-00256).
No proxy connection at or after 14:10 UTC appears in the supplied records, so the evidence does not cover the full alert-stated interval through 14:10.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections were initiated by the approved PixelForge updater or by an unauthorized process (T036-00101, T036-00144, T036-00178, T036-00208, T036-00235, T036-00242, T036-00256).

Which external destinations were contacted, and whether the proxied traffic was benign update activity or malicious command-and-control or data transfer (T036-00101, T036-00144, T036-00178, T036-00208, T036-00235, T036-00242, T036-00256).
Whether the observed activity continued between 14:05:48 and 14:10 UTC, or elsewhere in the review window without a corresponding supplied proxy record.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve proxy request and TLS/CONNECT logs for the listed connections, including requested hostnames, URLs where available, and policy or reputation results.

Obtain endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01 covering 13:20–14:20 UTC and verify the executable path, signature, and execution history of any process responsible for the connections.
Check PixelForge updater logs and software execution records for matching check times and destinations.
Retrieve proxy and endpoint records covering 14:05:48–14:20 UTC to determine whether the pattern continued and to complete the review interval.
